# Padding

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Padding

Padding is the space between the content of an element and its border.

Let's use the padding property to pad 'Buy Now' button on all four sides:

```html
1<h1>Sneakers on Sale</h1>
2<p>Step up your game with these trendy, ultra-comfortable sneakers designed for both performance and style. Perfect for casual wear or a workout!</p>
3<a href="#">Buy Now</a>
```

```css
1a {
2    background-color: #6603fc;
3    color: #ffffff;
4    text-decoration: none;
5    
6    /* Applies a padding of 10px */
7    padding: 10px;
8}
```

Browser Output

![Padding](data:image/png;base64,)

Here, padding of 10px is added on all sides between the content and border of the <a> element.
